method: Employer postings do not disclose compensation. Third-party benchmarks are context, not salaries offered for these vacancies. India location and role relevance were checked; pay basis, sample limits and mismatches appear in each CSV row. No currency conversion or take-home calculation is applied. Recheck sources when refreshing jobs.
